sourceReview.excerpt:
##### **Use equivalent number sentences involving multiplication and division to find unknown quantities**

- Complete number sentences that involve more than one operation by
  calculating missing numbers

+------------------------------------------------------------------+
|**Example(s):**|
||
|Such as $$5 \times \ \ \ \ \ ⃞ = 4 \times 10$$,|
|$$5 \times \ \ \ \ \ ⃞ = 30 - 10$$.|
+------------------------------------------------------------------+

- Identify and use inverse operations to assist with the solution of
  number sentences

+------------------------------------------------------------------+
|**Example(s):**|
||
|Such as $$125 \div 5 = \ \ \ \ \ ⃞$$ becomes|
|$$\ \ \ \ \ ⃞ \times 5 = 125$$.|
+------------------------------------------------------------------+
